notes: The kept 30 span the concept-defining senescence milestones (telomere- and oncogene-induced senescence as a DNA-damage response, the ATM/p53/p21-vs-p16 split, SAHF/macroH2A and Lamin B1 chromatin remodelling, mitochondrial-dysfunction and ROS-driven senescence/SASP), senescent-cell clearance plus the first senolytic and senomorphic demonstrations (ABT263, JAK inhibition, senescent-cell targeting in old age), immunosenescence (CD8/CD57, neutrophil PI3K), HSC/stem-cell ageing, DNA-methylation and biological-age clocks, telomere-protection biology, and the DAMP/sterile-inflammation and metaflammation arms of inflammasome-driven inflammaging (cholesterol crystals, oxidized mtDNA, necrosis, CD36, obesity/adipose NLRP3, the canonical age-related NLRP3 decline paper) across vascular, retinal and brain ageing tissues. It is thin on clonal haematopoiesis, cGAS-STING nucleic-acid sensing, and single-cell/multi-omic ageing atlases, which are essentially absent from this shortlist, and the inflammatory/proteomic clocks (e.g. iAge) postdate the landmark era. The last several picks (CD36 ligand-nucleation, adipocyte caspase-1, Alu-RNA/AMD, DDR/NKG2D senescence surveillance, AD-NLRP3) are the best-available borderline fits, kept over the many infection-specific and pure inflammasome-assembly papers that dominate the list because their contribution is a generalizable inflammaging mechanism rather than a disease-cohort finding.
